description: Owner-only. Finally close an OFFBOARDED_PAYABLE contract after every earned payment settles. Needed when the automatic close does not apply (preflight automaticClose not enabled or not eligible); an eligible contract can already have ended by itself, and a repeat close of a CLOSED contract is idempotent. Requires explicit confirm: true to acknowledge this live mutation.

confirm.description: Required explicit confirmation that this live contract mutation is intentional.

name: opentrain_close_contract
